title: Cohort Lifetime Value
description: For each customer cohort (their first purchase month), report **LTV** — the cohort's average total revenue per customer. Name the columns `cohort_month`, `customers` and `ltv` (rounded to 2 decimals). Return cohorts in chronological order.
solutionSql:
WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(order_date)) AS cohort_month
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
spend AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS total_spend
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT f.cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       ROUND(SUM(s.total_spend) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS ltv
FROM firsts f
JOIN spend s ON s.customer_id = f.customer_id
GROUP BY f.cohort_month
ORDER BY f.cohort_month;
hint: Cohort = first-purchase month. LTV = SUM of every cohort member's lifetime spend divided by cohort size.
outputExplanation: Jan cohort (customers 1,2) spent $500 total → LTV $250. Feb cohort (customer 3) spent $100 → LTV $100.
